contradictions.explanation: With only three houses, having Milo, Hana, and Dev all pairwise in different houses requires exactly three distinct houses among them, which is possible, but combined with Quinn also needing a house assignment (implied by the raffle/group context) it forces an impossible fourth distinct house since all four are part of the same small group without a stated fourth house.
